evidence_snippets: This is because the default custom extractor model type is a foundation model, which can perform zero-shot prediction, that is, without training.
At least 10 training instances and 10 test instances of each field are required for a custom model based processor.
In the Create processor menu, enter a name for your processor, such as my-custom-document-extractor .
